verdicts.title: Kramers-Wannier Duality of Statistical Mechanics Applied to the Boolean Satisfiability Problem of Computer Science
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a novel application of the Kramers-Wannier duality on one of the most important problems of computer science, the Boolean satisfiability problem (SAT). More specifically, we focus on sharp-SAT or equivalently #SAT - the problem of counting the number of solutions to a Boolean satisfaction formula. #SAT can be cast into a statistical-mechanical language, where it reduces to calculating the partition function of an Ising spin Hamiltonian with multi-spin interactions.
